children: LME copper (MCU3=LX) may slide into a range of $12,923-$13,003 per metric ton, driven by a wave c.
This wave has travelled below its 214.6% projection level of $13,309. Chances are it may extend to the 261.8% level of $13,003.
A retracement analysis on the uptrend from $11,705 to $14,894 reveals a support at $13,300, which has been pierced below. The next support is at $12,923.
Resistance is at $13,404, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $13,556-$13,654 range.
* The copper report is published weekly on Monday.
